newsitem.title: USA: Visual Edge arranges debt facility.
newsitem.headline: Visual Edge arranges debt facility.

text.p: Visual Edge Systems said Monday that it has arranged a three year, $7.5 million debt and convertible equity facility with a group of investments funds advised by an affiliate of Hunt Sports Group.
The company said the debt and convertible equity facility will be used to repay existing bank debt and for working capital.

The company said it may repay all or a portion of the facility prior to December 31, 1997. After that time, debt of $5,000,000 (if not redeemed) will be exchanged for $5,000,000 of Visual Edge convertible preferred stock.
The investment funds were paid a fee of 93,677 shares of Visual Edge common stock and 100,000 warrants to purchase additional shares of common stock at $10.675 per share.
Visual Edge also said it will begin to explore potential business opportunities with Hunt Sports.
Hunt Sports is a sports and entertainment management company controlled by the Lamar Hunt family of Dallas.
Visual Edge produces One-on-One with professional golfer Greg Norman - personalized videotape golf lessons which are sold to amateur, corporate, charity and member golf tournaments.
